summary: CICS online Admin Menu for administrator users. Like the main menu but exposes administrative options -- notably user management (list/add/update/delete users). Validates the selected option and transfers control (CICS XCTL) to the corresponding admin program. Reached only by users authenticated as Admin.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the admin menu. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return to sign-on; Enter process the selected admin option. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: the admin menu is only reachable by users whose type is Admin (enforced at sign-on).

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the entered admin option (numeric, in range); if valid, transfer control to the mapped admin program (e.g. user list/add/update/delete), passing the user context.
branches: ELSE XCTL to admin option program

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: admin option must be valid; selection routes to the corresponding admin function.

paragraphs.name: SEND-MENU-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and admin option list and send the menu map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the admin menu map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build the admin option list from the menu-definition copybook.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return control to the sign-on program (sign off).
